<?php

function sequenceCompare(mixed $a, mixed $b): int
{
    if (!is_array($a))
        return $a <=> $b;
    $n = min(count($a), count($b));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
        $cmp = sequenceCompare($a[$i], $b[$i]);
        if ($cmp)
            return $cmp;
    }
    return count($a) <=> count($b);
}

function denseRanks(array $values): array
{
    $order = array_keys($values);
    usort($order, fn($a, $b) => sequenceCompare($values[$a], $values[$b]));
    $ranks = [];
    $previous = null;
    $rank = 0;
    foreach ($order as $i) {
        if ($previous === null || sequenceCompare($values[$i], $previous) !== 0)
            ++$rank;
        $ranks[$i] = $rank;
        $previous = $values[$i];
    }
    ksort($ranks, SORT_NUMERIC);
    return array_values($ranks);
}

function refine(Molecule $m, array $ranks): array
{
    while (true) {
        $values = [];
        foreach ($m->neighbors as $i => $neighbors) {
            $pairs = [];
            foreach ($neighbors as $j => $b)
                $pairs[] = [$ranks[$j], $b->kind];
            usort($pairs, sequenceCompare(...));
            $values[] = [$ranks[$i], $pairs];
        }
        $new = denseRanks($values);
        if (count(array_unique($new)) === count(array_unique($ranks)))
            return $new;
        $ranks = $new;
    }
}

function canonicalRanks(Molecule $m): array
{
    $values = [];
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a)
        $values[] = [
            $m->degree($i),
            $a->element->number,
            $a->mass,
            $a->charge,
            $a->hydrogens,
            (int) $a->aromatic,
        ];
    $ranks = refine($m, denseRanks($values));
    $classes = count(array_unique($ranks));
    while (count(array_unique($ranks)) !== count($ranks)) {
        $counts = array_count_values($ranks);
        $ties = array_keys(array_filter($counts, fn($n) => $n > 1));
        $first = array_search(min($ties), $ranks, true);
        $values = [];
        foreach ($ranks as $i => $rank)
            $values[] = (2 * $rank) - (int) ($i === $first);
        $ranks = refine($m, denseRanks($values));
    }
    return [$ranks, $classes];
}

function atomNotation(Molecule $m, int $i): string
{
    $a = $m->atoms[$i];
    $symbol = $a->element->symbol;
    $ordinary =
        in_array($symbol, ORGANIC, true)
        && (!$a->aromatic || in_array($symbol, AROMATIC, true))
        && $a->mass === 0
        && $a->charge === 0;
    if ($a->aromatic) {
        $ordinary = $ordinary && needsPi($m, $i) === needsPi($m, $i, 0);
        $symbol = strtolower($symbol);
    }
    $h = organicHydrogens($a, $m->bondTotal($i));
    if ($ordinary && $h !== null && $h === $a->hydrogens)
        return $symbol;
    $text = '[' . ($a->mass ? (string) $a->mass : '') . $symbol;
    if ($a->hydrogens)
        $text .= 'H' . ($a->hydrogens === 1 ? '' : (string) $a->hydrogens);
    if ($a->charge)
        $text .= ($a->charge > 0 ? '+' : '-') . (abs($a->charge) === 1 ? '' : (string) abs($a->charge));
    return $text . ']';
}

function bondSymbol(Molecule $m, Bond $b): string
{
    [$a, $c] = $b->ends;
    $inside = $b->ring && $m->atoms[$a]->aromatic && $m->atoms[$c]->aromatic;
    return match ($b->kind) {
        1 => $inside ? '-' : '',
        2 => '=',
        3 => '#',
        4 => $inside ? '' : ':',
    };
}

function canonicalSmiles(Molecule $m, array $ranks): string
{
    $visits = $closures = [];
    $children = array_fill(0, count($m->atoms), []);
    $visit = function (int $a, ?Bond $incoming) use (
        &$visit,
        &$visits,
        &$children,
        &$closures,
        $m,
        $ranks,
    ): void {
        $visits[$a] = count($visits) + 1;
        $neighbors = array_keys($m->neighbors[$a]);
        usort($neighbors, fn($x, $y) => $ranks[$x] <=> $ranks[$y]);
        foreach ($neighbors as $b) {
            $bond = $m->neighbors[$a][$b];
            if ($bond === $incoming || isset($closures[$bond->key()]))
                continue;
            if (!isset($visits[$b])) {
                $children[$a][] = [$b, $bond];
                $visit($b, $bond);
            } else
                $closures[$bond->key()] = true;
        }
    };
    $root = array_search(1, $ranks, true);
    $visit($root, null);
    $assignments = $occupied = [];
    $write = function (int $a) use (
        &$write,
        &$assignments,
        &$occupied,
        $children,
        $closures,
        $visits,
        $m,
    ): string {
        $text = atomNotation($m, $a);
        $neighbors = array_keys($m->neighbors[$a]);
        usort($neighbors, fn($x, $y) => $visits[$x] <=> $visits[$y]);
        foreach ($neighbors as $b) {
            $bond = $m->neighbors[$a][$b];
            $key = $bond->key();
            if (!isset($closures[$key]))
                continue;
            if (isset($assignments[$key])) {
                $n = $assignments[$key];
                unset($assignments[$key], $occupied[$n]);
                $symbol = '';
            } else {
                $n = 1;
                while (isset($occupied[$n]))
                    ++$n;
                $assignments[$key] = $n;
                $occupied[$n] = true;
                $symbol = bondSymbol($m, $bond);
            }
            $text .= $symbol . ($n < 10 ? (string) $n : sprintf('%%%02d', $n));
        }
        foreach ($children[$a] as $i => [$child, $bond]) {
            $part = bondSymbol($m, $bond) . $write($child);
            $text .= ($i + 1) < count($children[$a]) ? '(' . $part . ')' : $part;
        }
        return $text;
    };
    return $write($root);
}

function canonicalize(Molecule $m): array
{
    [$ranks, $classes] = canonicalRanks($m);
    return [canonicalSmiles($m, $ranks), $classes];
}

<?php

foreach (['molecule', 'smiles_parser', 'rings_aromatic', 'canonical', 'search'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
const ARGUMENT_COUNTS = [
    'MATCH' => [1, 1],
    'CONTAINS' => [2, 2],
    'MATRIX' => [2, 12],
    'NEAREST' => [2, 2],
    'WITHIN' => [2, 2],
    'COMPARE' => [2, 2],
    'CLUSTER' => [1, 1],
];

const SYSTEM_KINDS = ['isolated', 'fused', 'spiro', 'bridged'];

function dataLines(string $name): array
{
    $result = [];
    foreach (file('input/' . $name, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $i => $line)
        if ($line !== '' && $line[0] !== '#')
            $result[] = [$i + 1, $line];
    return $result;
}

function validName(string $text): bool
{
    return (bool) preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}\z/', $text);
}

function validNumber(string $text, int $lo, int $hi): bool
{
    return (
        preg_match('/\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\z/', $text)
        && strlen($text) <= strlen((string) $hi)
        && (int) $text >= $lo
        && (int) $text <= $hi
    );
}

function readThreshold(string $text): ?array
{
    $parts = explode('/', $text);
    if (
        count($parts) !== 2
        || !validNumber($parts[0], 0, 99)
        || !validNumber($parts[1], 1, 99)
        || (int) $parts[0] > (int) $parts[1]
    )
        return null;
    return [(int) $parts[0], (int) $parts[1]];
}

function fractionText(array $f): string
{
    [$a, $b] = $f;
    $x = $a;
    $y = $b;
    while ($y)
        [$x, $y] = [$y, $x % $y];
    return intdiv($a, $x) . '/' . intdiv($b, $x);
}

function fractionCompare(array $a, array $b): int
{
    return ($a[0] * $b[1]) <=> ($b[0] * $a[1]);
}

function atomNumbers(array $numbers, string $separator = ','): string
{
    return implode($separator, array_map(fn($i) => $i + 1, $numbers));
}

function memberNames(array $molecules): string
{
    return implode(',', array_map(fn($m) => $m->name, $molecules));
}

function increment(array &$counts, string|int $key, int $amount = 1): void
{
    $counts[$key] = ($counts[$key] ?? 0) + $amount;
}

function analyze(Molecule $m): void
{
    findRings($m);
    foreach ($m->bonds as $b) {
        if ($b->symbol !== null)
            $b->kind = BOND_TYPES[$b->symbol];
        else {
            [$a, $c] = $b->ends;
            $b->kind = $m->atoms[$a]->aromatic && $m->atoms[$c]->aromatic && $b->ring ? 4 : 1;
        }
    }
    $needing = [];
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a)
        if (needsPi($m, $i))
            $needing[] = $i;
    kekulize($m, $needing);
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a) {
        $total = $m->bondTotal($i);
        if ($a->bracket) {
            if (($total + $a->hydrogens) > (max($a->element->valences) + abs($a->charge)))
                throw new AnalysisError('bad valence', $a->column);
        } else {
            $h = organicHydrogens($a, $total);
            if ($h === null)
                throw new AnalysisError('bad valence', $a->column);
            $a->hydrogens = $h;
        }
    }
}

function molecularProperties(Molecule $m): array
{
    $counts = [];
    $hydrogens = $weight = $heavy = $donors = $acceptors = $charge = 0;
    $heavyDegrees = $triple = [];
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a) {
        increment($counts, $a->element->symbol);
        $hydrogens += $a->hydrogens;
        $weight += $a->mass ? $a->mass * 1000 : $a->element->weight;
        $heavy += (int) ($a->element->symbol !== 'H');
        $charge += $a->charge;
        $heavyDegrees[$i] = count(array_filter(
            array_keys($m->neighbors[$i]),
            fn($j) => $m->atoms[$j]->element->symbol !== 'H',
        ));
        if ($a->element->symbol === 'N' || $a->element->symbol === 'O') {
            ++$acceptors;
            $attached = $a->hydrogens;
            foreach ($m->neighbors[$i] as $j => $b)
                $attached += (int) ($m->atoms[$j]->element->symbol === 'H');
            $donors += (int) ($attached >= 1);
        }
    }
    increment($counts, 'H', $hydrogens);
    $weight += $hydrogens * $m->elements['H']->weight;
    $symbols = array_keys(array_filter($counts));
    usort($symbols, strcmp(...));
    if ($counts['C'] ?? 0) {
        $symbols = array_values(array_diff($symbols, ['C', 'H']));
        $symbols = $counts['H'] ?? 0 ? ['C', 'H', ...$symbols] : ['C', ...$symbols];
    }
    $formula = '';
    foreach ($symbols as $symbol)
        $formula .= $symbol . ($counts[$symbol] === 1 ? '' : $counts[$symbol]);
    foreach ($m->bonds as $b)
        if ($b->multiplicity === 3)
            foreach ($b->ends as $i)
                $triple[$i] = true;
    $rotatable = 0;
    foreach ($m->bonds as $b) {
        [$a, $c] = $b->ends;
        if (
            $b->multiplicity === 1
            && !$b->ring
            && $heavyDegrees[$a] >= 2
            && $heavyDegrees[$c] >= 2
            && !isset($triple[$a])
            && !isset($triple[$c])
        )
            ++$rotatable;
    }
    $violations = (int) ($weight > 500000) + (int) ($donors > 5) + (int) ($acceptors > 10);
    return [
        'formula' => $formula,
        'weight' => $weight,
        'heavy' => $heavy,
        'rotatable' => $rotatable,
        'donors' => $donors,
        'acceptors' => $acceptors,
        'lipinski' => $violations <= 1 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
        'charge' => $charge,
    ];
}

function scaffoldMolecule(Molecule $m): ?Molecule
{
    if (!$m->rings)
        return null;
    $remaining = array_fill_keys(array_keys($m->atoms), true);
    while (true) {
        $leaf = null;
        foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a)
            if (
                isset($remaining[$i])
                && !isset($m->ringAtoms[$i])
                && count(array_intersect_key($m->neighbors[$i], $remaining)) === 1
            ) {
                $leaf = $i;
                break;
            }
        if ($leaf === null)
            break;
        unset($remaining[$leaf]);
    }
    $kept = $remaining;
    foreach ($remaining as $i => $unused)
        foreach ($m->neighbors[$i] as $j => $b)
            if (!isset($remaining[$j]) && $b->kind === 2)
                $kept[$j] = true;
    $scaffold = new Molecule($m->elements);
    $renumber = [];
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a)
        if (isset($kept[$i])) {
            $added = 0;
            foreach ($m->neighbors[$i] as $j => $b)
                if (!isset($kept[$j]))
                    $added += $b->multiplicity;
            $renumber[$i] = $scaffold->addAtom(
                new Atom(
                    $a->element,
                    $a->aromatic,
                    $a->mass,
                    $a->charge,
                    $a->hydrogens + $added,
                    $a->bracket,
                    $a->column,
                ),
            );
        }
    foreach ($m->orderedBonds() as $b) {
        [$a, $c] = $b->ends;
        if (isset($kept[$a], $kept[$c])) {
            $copy = $scaffold->addBond($renumber[$a], $renumber[$c], $b->symbol);
            $copy->kind = $b->kind;
            $copy->multiplicity = $b->multiplicity;
            $copy->ring = $b->ring;
        }
    }
    foreach ($m->rings as $ring)
        $scaffold->rings[] = array_map(fn($i) => $renumber[$i], $ring);
    foreach ($m->ringAtoms as $i => $unused)
        $scaffold->ringAtoms[$renumber[$i]] = true;
    return $scaffold;
}

function ringSystems(Molecule $m): array
{
    $sets = array_map(fn($r) => array_fill_keys($r, true), $m->rings);
    $connections = array_fill(0, count($sets), []);
    $relations = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($sets); ++$i)
        for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($sets); ++$j) {
            $shared = array_keys(array_intersect_key($sets[$i], $sets[$j]));
            $n = count($shared);
            if (!$n)
                continue;
            $connections[$i][$j] = $connections[$j][$i] = true;
            if ($n === 1)
                $kind = 'spiro';
            elseif ($n === 2)
                $kind = isset($m->neighbors[$shared[0]][$shared[1]]) ? 'fused' : 'bridged';
            else
                $kind = 'bridged';
            $relations[] = [$i, $j, $kind];
        }
    $unseen = array_fill_keys(array_keys($sets), true);
    $systems = [];
    while ($unseen) {
        $start = min(array_keys($unseen));
        unset($unseen[$start]);
        $component = [$start => true];
        $queue = [$start];
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($queue); ++$i)
            foreach ($connections[$queue[$i]] as $j => $unused)
                if (isset($unseen[$j])) {
                    unset($unseen[$j]);
                    $component[$j] = true;
                    $queue[] = $j;
                }
        $kinds = [];
        foreach ($relations as [$i, $j, $kind])
            if (isset($component[$i], $component[$j]))
                $kinds[$kind] = true;
        $kind = count($component) === 1
            ? 'isolated'
            : (isset($kinds['bridged']) ? 'bridged' : (isset($kinds['fused']) ? 'fused' : 'spiro'));
        $atoms = [];
        foreach ($component as $i => $unused)
            $atoms += $sets[$i];
        $rings = array_keys($component);
        sort($rings, SORT_NUMERIC);
        $systems[] = ['rings' => $rings, 'atoms' => count($atoms), 'kind' => $kind];
    }
    return $systems;
}

function prepareMolecules(array $molecules): void
{
    foreach ($molecules as $m) {
        $m->properties = molecularProperties($m);
        [$m->canonical, $m->classes] = canonicalize($m);
        $scaffold = scaffoldMolecule($m);
        $m->scaffold = $scaffold === null ? null : canonicalize($scaffold)[0];
        $m->systems = ringSystems($m);
        foreach ($m->rings as $ring)
            $m->aromaticRings[] = array_all($ring, fn($i) => $m->atoms[$i]->aromatic);
        [$m->bits, $m->paths] = fingerprint($m);
    }
}

function checkQuery(array &$q, array $elements, array $byName): ?string
{
    $kind = $q['type'];
    $arguments = $q['arguments'];
    [$lo, $hi] = ARGUMENT_COUNTS[$kind];
    if (count($arguments) < $lo || count($arguments) > $hi)
        return 'bad arguments';
    if ($kind === 'MATCH') {
        try {
            $q['pattern'] = parseSmiles($arguments[0], $elements, true);
        } catch (AnalysisError $e) {
            return "bad pattern {$e->reason} at column {$e->column}";
        }
    } elseif ($kind === 'CLUSTER') {
        $q['threshold'] = readThreshold($arguments[0]);
        if ($q['threshold'] === null)
            return 'bad threshold';
    } elseif (in_array($kind, ['CONTAINS', 'MATRIX', 'COMPARE'], true)) {
        foreach ($arguments as $name)
            if (!isset($byName[$name]))
                return 'unknown molecule ' . $name;
        if (count(array_unique($arguments, SORT_STRING)) !== count($arguments))
            return 'repeated molecule';
    } else {
        if (!isset($byName[$arguments[0]]))
            return 'unknown molecule ' . $arguments[0];
        if ($kind === 'NEAREST') {
            if (!validNumber($arguments[1], 1, 99))
                return 'bad count';
            $q['count'] = (int) $arguments[1];
        } else {
            $q['threshold'] = readThreshold($arguments[1]);
            if ($q['threshold'] === null)
                return 'bad threshold';
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function readMolecules(array $elements, array &$causes): array
{
    $molecules = $errors = $reserved = [];
    $lines = dataLines('molecules.smi');
    foreach ($lines as [$lineNumber, $line]) {
        $tokens = explode(' ', $line);
        if (count($tokens) !== 2 || $tokens[0] === '' || !validName($tokens[1])) {
            $errors[] = "line $lineNumber: bad line";
            increment($causes, 'bad line');
            continue;
        }
        [$smiles, $name] = $tokens;
        if (isset($reserved[$name])) {
            $errors[] = "line $lineNumber $name: duplicate name";
            increment($causes, 'duplicate name');
            continue;
        }
        $reserved[$name] = true;
        try {
            $m = parseSmiles($smiles, $elements);
            analyze($m);
        } catch (AnalysisError $e) {
            $errors[] = "line $lineNumber $name: {$e->reason} at column {$e->column}";
            increment($causes, $e->reason);
            continue;
        }
        $m->name = $name;
        $m->order = count($molecules);
        $molecules[] = $m;
    }
    return [
        $molecules,
        [
            'MOLECULES lines=' . count($lines) . ' valid=' . count($molecules) . ' errors=' . count($errors),
            ...$errors,
        ],
    ];
}

function readQueries(array $elements, array $byName, array &$causes): array
{
    $queries = $errors = $reserved = [];
    $lines = dataLines('queries.txt');
    foreach ($lines as [$number, $line]) {
        $tokens = explode(' ', $line);
        $kind = $tokens[0];
        $id = $tokens[1] ?? null;
        if (!isset(ARGUMENT_COUNTS[$kind]))
            $reason = 'unknown query';
        elseif ($id === null || !validName($id))
            $reason = 'bad id';
        elseif (isset($reserved[$id]))
            $reason = 'duplicate id';
        else {
            $reserved[$id] = true;
            $q = ['type' => $kind, 'id' => $id, 'arguments' => array_slice($tokens, 2)];
            $reason = checkQuery($q, $elements, $byName);
            if ($reason === null) {
                $queries[] = $q;
                continue;
            }
        }
        $errors[] = $reason === 'unknown query'
            ? "line $number: unknown query"
            : ($reason === 'bad id' ? "line $number $kind: bad id" : "line $number $kind $id: $reason");
        $cause = str_starts_with($reason, 'bad pattern ')
            ? 'bad pattern'
            : (str_starts_with($reason, 'unknown molecule ') ? 'unknown molecule' : $reason);
        increment($causes, $cause);
    }
    return [
        $queries,
        [
            'QUERIES lines=' . count($lines) . ' valid=' . count($queries) . ' errors=' . count($errors),
            ...$errors,
        ],
    ];
}

function propertiesLines(array $molecules): array
{
    $lines = ['name,formula,weight,heavy_atoms,rings,rotatable,donors,acceptors,lipinski'];
    foreach ($molecules as $m) {
        $p = $m->properties;
        $weight = intdiv($p['weight'], 1000) . '.' . sprintf('%03d', $p['weight'] % 1000);
        $lines[] = implode(',', [
            $m->name,
            $p['formula'],
            $weight,
            $p['heavy'],
            count($m->rings),
            $p['rotatable'],
            $p['donors'],
            $p['acceptors'],
            $p['lipinski'],
        ]);
    }
    return $lines;
}

function canonicalParagraphs(array $molecules): array
{
    $canonicalGroups = $formulaGroups = $scaffoldGroups = [];
    $acyclic = 0;
    foreach ($molecules as $m) {
        $canonicalGroups[$m->canonical][] = $m;
        $formulaGroups[$m->properties['formula']][] = $m;
        if ($m->scaffold === null)
            ++$acyclic;
        else
            $scaffoldGroups[$m->scaffold][] = $m;
    }
    $canonical = ['CANONICAL molecules=' . count($molecules) . ' unique=' . count($canonicalGroups)];
    foreach ($molecules as $m) {
        $charge = $m->properties['charge'];
        $canonical[] =
            "{$m->name} {$m->canonical} classes={$m->classes} charge=" . ($charge > 0 ? '+' : '') . $charge;
    }
    $groups = array_filter($canonicalGroups, fn($members) => count($members) >= 2);
    $count = array_sum(array_map(count(...), $groups));
    $duplicates = ['DUPLICATES groups=' . count($groups) . " molecules=$count"];
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($groups as $smiles => $members)
        $duplicates[] = 'group ' . ++$i . " $smiles members=" . memberNames($members);
    $groups = [];
    foreach ($formulaGroups as $formula => $members) {
        $forms = count(array_unique(array_map(fn($m) => $m->canonical, $members), SORT_STRING));
        if ($forms >= 2)
            $groups[] = [$formula, $members, $forms];
    }
    $isomers = ['ISOMERS groups=' . count($groups)];
    foreach ($groups as $i => [$formula, $members, $forms])
        $isomers[] = 'isomer ' . ($i + 1) . " $formula forms=$forms members=" . memberNames($members);
    $scaffolds = ['SCAFFOLDS distinct=' . count($scaffoldGroups) . " acyclic=$acyclic"];
    $keys = array_keys($scaffoldGroups);
    usort(
        $keys,
        fn($a, $b) => (
            count($scaffoldGroups[$b]) <=> count($scaffoldGroups[$a]) ?: strcmp((string) $a, (string) $b)
        ),
    );
    foreach ($keys as $i => $smiles)
        $scaffolds[] =
            'scaffold '
            . ($i + 1)
            . " $smiles count="
            . count($scaffoldGroups[$smiles])
            . ' members='
            . memberNames($scaffoldGroups[$smiles]);
    return [$canonical, $duplicates, $isomers, $scaffolds];
}

function ringParagraphs(array $molecules): array
{
    $paragraphs = $sizes = [];
    $kinds = array_fill_keys(SYSTEM_KINDS, 0);
    $totalAromatic = $totalRings = 0;
    foreach ($molecules as $m) {
        if (!$m->rings)
            continue;
        $aromatic = count(array_filter($m->aromaticRings));
        $totalAromatic += $aromatic;
        $totalRings += count($m->rings);
        $ringBonds = count(array_filter($m->bonds, fn($b) => $b->ring));
        $p = [
            "MOLECULE {$m->name} atoms="
                . count($m->atoms)
                . ' bonds='
                . count($m->bonds)
                . ' rings='
                . count($m->rings)
                . " aromatic=$aromatic systems="
                . count($m->systems)
                . ' ring_atoms='
                . count($m->ringAtoms)
                . " ring_bonds=$ringBonds",
        ];
        foreach ($m->rings as $i => $ring) {
            $hetero = count(array_filter($ring, fn($a) => $m->atoms[$a]->element->symbol !== 'C'));
            $flag = $m->aromaticRings[$i] ? 'yes' : 'no';
            $p[] =
                'ring '
                . ($i + 1)
                . ' size='
                . count($ring)
                . " aromatic=$flag hetero=$hetero atoms="
                . atomNumbers($ring, '-');
            increment($sizes, count($ring));
        }
        foreach ($m->systems as $i => $s) {
            ++$kinds[$s['kind']];
            $p[] =
                'system '
                . ($i + 1)
                . " kind={$s['kind']} rings="
                . atomNumbers($s['rings'])
                . " atoms={$s['atoms']}";
        }
        $doubles = [];
        foreach ($m->orderedBonds() as $b)
            if ($b->kind === 4 && $b->multiplicity === 2)
                $doubles[] = atomNumbers($b->ends, '=');
        $p[] = 'kekule ' . ($doubles ? implode(' ', $doubles) : '-');
        $paragraphs[] = $p;
    }
    $summary = [
        'SUMMARY molecules='
            . count($molecules)
            . ' cyclic='
            . count($paragraphs)
            . " rings=$totalRings aromatic=$totalAromatic",
    ];
    $parts = [];
    ksort($sizes, SORT_NUMERIC);
    foreach ($sizes as $size => $n)
        $parts[] = "$size=$n";
    $summary[] = 'sizes ' . ($parts ? implode(' ', $parts) : '-');
    $parts = [];
    foreach (SYSTEM_KINDS as $kind)
        $parts[] = $kind . '=' . $kinds[$kind];
    $summary[] = 'systems ' . implode(' ', $parts);
    $paragraphs[] = $summary;
    return $paragraphs;
}

function substructureParagraphs(array $queries, array $molecules, array $byName): array
{
    $paragraphs = [];
    $patterns = $hits = $contains = $found = 0;
    foreach ($queries as $q) {
        $kind = $q['type'];
        $id = $q['id'];
        $args = $q['arguments'];
        if ($kind === 'MATCH') {
            ++$patterns;
            $pattern = $q['pattern'];
            $matches = [];
            $total = 0;
            foreach ($molecules as $m) {
                [$count, $unique, $mapping] = embeddings($pattern, $m);
                if ($count) {
                    $matches[] = [$m, $count, $unique, $mapping];
                    $total += $count;
                }
            }
            $hits += count($matches);
            $p = [
                "MATCH $id {$args[0]} atoms="
                    . count($pattern->atoms)
                    . ' bonds='
                    . count($pattern->bonds)
                    . ' hits='
                    . count($matches)
                    . " embeddings=$total",
            ];
            $top = null;
            foreach ($matches as [$m, $count, $unique, $mapping]) {
                $p[] = "{$m->name} count=$count unique=$unique map=" . atomNumbers($mapping);
                if ($top === null || $count > $top[1])
                    $top = [$m, $count];
            }
            if ($top !== null)
                $p[] = "top {$top[0]->name} count={$top[1]}";
            $paragraphs[] = $p;
        } elseif ($kind === 'CONTAINS') {
            ++$contains;
            $a = $byName[$args[0]];
            $b = $byName[$args[1]];
            [$count, $unique, $mapping] = embeddings(moleculePattern($a), $b);
            $text = "CONTAINS $id {$a->name} {$b->name} result=";
            if ($count) {
                ++$found;
                $text .= "yes count=$count unique=$unique map=" . atomNumbers($mapping);
            } else
                $text .= 'no';
            $paragraphs[] = [$text];
        }
    }
    $paragraphs[] = ["SUMMARY patterns=$patterns hits=$hits contains=$contains found=$found"];
    return $paragraphs;
}

final class Similarities
{
    private array $cache = [];

    public function get(Molecule $a, Molecule $b): array
    {
        $key = min($a->order, $b->order) . ':' . max($a->order, $b->order);
        return $this->cache[$key] ??= tanimoto($a->bits, $b->bits);
    }
}

function similarityParagraphs(array $queries, array $molecules, array $byName): array
{
    $fingerprints = ['FINGERPRINTS molecules=' . count($molecules) . ' size=1024 depth=5'];
    foreach ($molecules as $m)
        $fingerprints[] = "{$m->name} bits=" . count($m->bits) . " paths={$m->paths}";
    $paragraphs = [$fingerprints];
    $similarities = new Similarities();
    foreach ($queries as $q) {
        $kind = $q['type'];
        $id = $q['id'];
        $args = $q['arguments'];
        $p = [];
        if ($kind === 'MATRIX') {
            $selected = array_map(fn($name) => $byName[$name], $args);
            $p = ["MATRIX $id size=" . count($selected)];
            foreach ($selected as $a)
                $p[] =
                    'row '
                    . $a->name
                    . ' '
                    . implode(' ', array_map(fn($b) => fractionText($similarities->get($a, $b)), $selected));
            $best = null;
            $first = $second = null;
            foreach ($selected as $i => $a)
                for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($selected); ++$j) {
                    $value = $similarities->get($a, $selected[$j]);
                    if ($best === null || fractionCompare($value, $best) > 0) {
                        $first = $a;
                        $second = $selected[$j];
                        $best = $value;
                    }
                }
            $p[] = "best {$first->name} {$second->name} " . fractionText($best);
        } elseif ($kind === 'NEAREST' || $kind === 'WITHIN') {
            $source = $byName[$args[0]];
            $neighbors = [];
            foreach ($molecules as $m)
                if ($m !== $source)
                    $neighbors[] = [$m, $similarities->get($source, $m)];
            usort($neighbors, fn($a, $b) => fractionCompare($b[1], $a[1]) ?: $a[0]->order <=> $b[0]->order);
            if ($kind === 'NEAREST') {
                $neighbors = array_slice($neighbors, 0, $q['count']);
                $heading = "NEAREST $id {$source->name} count=" . count($neighbors);
            } else {
                $neighbors = array_values(array_filter(
                    $neighbors,
                    fn($r) => fractionCompare($r[1], $q['threshold']) >= 0,
                ));
                $heading =
                    "WITHIN $id {$source->name} threshold="
                    . fractionText($q['threshold'])
                    . ' count='
                    . count($neighbors);
            }
            $p = [$heading];
            foreach ($neighbors as $i => [$m, $value])
                $p[] = ($i + 1) . " {$m->name} " . fractionText($value) . " common={$value[0]}";
        } elseif ($kind === 'COMPARE') {
            $a = $byName[$args[0]];
            $b = $byName[$args[1]];
            $value = $similarities->get($a, $b);
            $p[] =
                "COMPARE $id {$a->name} {$b->name} bits="
                . count($a->bits)
                . ','
                . count($b->bits)
                . " common={$value[0]} union={$value[1]} tanimoto="
                . fractionText($value)
                . ' identical='
                . ($a->canonical === $b->canonical ? 'yes' : 'no');
        } elseif ($kind === 'CLUSTER') {
            $neighbors = [];
            foreach ($molecules as $i => $a) {
                $neighbors[$i] = [];
                foreach ($molecules as $j => $b)
                    if ($i !== $j && fractionCompare($similarities->get($a, $b), $q['threshold']) >= 0)
                        $neighbors[$i][] = $j;
            }
            $order = array_keys($molecules);
            usort($order, fn($a, $b) => count($neighbors[$b]) <=> count($neighbors[$a]) ?: $a <=> $b);
            $assigned = $clusters = [];
            foreach ($order as $center)
                if (!isset($assigned[$center])) {
                    $members = [$center];
                    foreach ($neighbors[$center] as $j)
                        if (!isset($assigned[$j]))
                            $members[] = $j;
                    foreach ($members as $j)
                        $assigned[$j] = true;
                    $clusters[] = $members;
                }
            $singletons = count(array_filter($clusters, fn($r) => count($r) === 1));
            $p = [
                "CLUSTER $id threshold="
                    . fractionText($q['threshold'])
                    . ' clusters='
                    . count($clusters)
                    . " singletons=$singletons",
            ];
            $number = 0;
            foreach ($clusters as $members)
                if (count($members) >= 2) {
                    $selected = array_map(fn($i) => $molecules[$i], $members);
                    $p[] =
                        'cluster '
                        . ++$number
                        . " centroid={$selected[0]->name} size="
                        . count($selected)
                        . ' members='
                        . memberNames($selected);
                }
        } else
            continue;
        $paragraphs[] = $p;
    }
    return $paragraphs;
}

function paragraphsText(array $paragraphs): string
{
    return implode("\n\n", array_map(fn($p) => implode("\n", $p), $paragraphs)) . "\n";
}

function main(): void
{
    $elements = readElements();
    $causes = [];
    [$molecules, $moleculeErrors] = readMolecules($elements, $causes);
    prepareMolecules($molecules);
    $byName = [];
    foreach ($molecules as $m)
        $byName[$m->name] = $m;
    [$queries, $queryErrors] = readQueries($elements, $byName, $causes);
    $causeLines = ['CAUSES kinds=' . count($causes)];
    $reasons = array_keys($causes);
    usort($reasons, fn($a, $b) => $causes[$b] <=> $causes[$a] ?: strcmp($a, $b));
    foreach ($reasons as $reason)
        $causeLines[] = $reason . '=' . $causes[$reason];
    $outputs = [
        'properties.csv' => implode("\n", propertiesLines($molecules)) . "\n",
        'canonical.txt' => paragraphsText(canonicalParagraphs($molecules)),
        'rings.txt' => paragraphsText(ringParagraphs($molecules)),
        'substructure.txt' => paragraphsText(substructureParagraphs($queries, $molecules, $byName)),
        'similarity.txt' => paragraphsText(similarityParagraphs($queries, $molecules, $byName)),
        'errors.txt' => paragraphsText([$moleculeErrors, $queryErrors, $causeLines]),
    ];
    if (!is_dir('output'))
        mkdir('output');
    foreach ($outputs as $name => $text)
        file_put_contents('output/' . $name, $text);
}

main();

<?php

const ORGANIC = ['B', 'C', 'N', 'O', 'P', 'S', 'F', 'Cl', 'Br', 'I'];

const AROMATIC = ['B', 'C', 'N', 'O', 'P', 'S'];

const BOND_TYPES = ['-' => 1, '/' => 1, '\\' => 1, '=' => 2, '#' => 3, ':' => 4];

const BASE_VALUES = [0, 1, 2, 3, 1];

final readonly class Element
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $symbol,
        public int $number,
        public int $weight,
        public array $valences,
    ) {}
}

final class AnalysisError extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $reason,
        public int $column,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($reason);
    }
}

final class Atom
{
    public function __construct(
        public Element $element,
        public bool $aromatic = false,
        public int $mass = 0,
        public int $charge = 0,
        public int $hydrogens = 0,
        public bool $bracket = false,
        public int $column = 0,
    ) {}
}

final class Bond
{
    public array $ends;
    public ?int $kind = null;
    public int $multiplicity = 0;
    public bool $ring = false;

    public function __construct(
        int $a,
        int $b,
        public string|int|null $symbol,
    ) {
        $this->ends = [min($a, $b), max($a, $b)];
    }

    public function key(): string
    {
        return $this->ends[0] . ':' . $this->ends[1];
    }
}

function bondKey(int $a, int $b): string
{
    return min($a, $b) . ':' . max($a, $b);
}

final class Molecule
{
    public array
        $atoms = [],
        $neighbors = [],
        $bonds = [],
        $rings = [],
        $ringAtoms = [],
        $properties = [],
        $systems = [],
        $aromaticRings = [],
        $bits = []
    ;
    public string $name = '', $canonical = '';
    public ?string $scaffold = null;
    public int $order = 0, $classes = 0, $paths = 0;

    public function __construct(
        public array $elements,
    ) {}

    public function addAtom(object $atom): int
    {
        $n = count($this->atoms);
        $this->atoms[] = $atom;
        $this->neighbors[] = [];
        return $n;
    }

    public function addBond(int $a, int $b, string|int|null $symbol): Bond
    {
        $bond = new Bond($a, $b, $symbol);
        $this->bonds[$bond->key()] = $bond;
        $this->neighbors[$a][$b] = $this->neighbors[$b][$a] = $bond;
        return $bond;
    }

    public function orderedBonds(): array
    {
        $bonds = array_values($this->bonds);
        usort($bonds, fn($a, $b) => $a->ends <=> $b->ends);
        return $bonds;
    }

    public function degree(int $i): int
    {
        return count($this->neighbors[$i]);
    }

    public function baseTotal(int $i): int
    {
        return array_sum(array_map(fn($b) => BASE_VALUES[$b->kind], $this->neighbors[$i]));
    }

    public function bondTotal(int $i): int
    {
        return array_sum(array_map(fn($b) => $b->multiplicity, $this->neighbors[$i]));
    }
}

function readElements(): array
{
    $elements = [];
    foreach (file('input/elements.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        if ($line === '' || $line[0] === '#')
            continue;
        [$symbol, $number, $weight, $valences] = explode(' ', $line);
        $elements[$symbol] = new Element(
            $symbol,
            (int) $number,
            (int) $weight,
            array_map(intval(...), explode(',', $valences)),
        );
    }
    return $elements;
}

function needsPi(Molecule $m, int $i, ?int $hydrogens = null): bool
{
    $a = $m->atoms[$i];
    $hydrogens ??= $a->hydrogens;
    return $a->aromatic && ($a->element->valences[0] + $a->charge) >= ($m->baseTotal($i) + $hydrogens + 1);
}

function organicHydrogens(Atom $atom, int $total): ?int
{
    foreach ($atom->element->valences as $v)
        if ($v >= $total)
            return $v - $total;
    return null;
}

<?php

function breadthFirst(Molecule $m, int $root): array
{
    $parents = [$root => null];
    $queue = [$root];
    for ($j = 0; $j < count($queue); ++$j) {
        $a = $queue[$j];
        $neighbors = array_keys($m->neighbors[$a]);
        sort($neighbors, SORT_NUMERIC);
        foreach ($neighbors as $b)
            if (!array_key_exists($b, $parents)) {
                $parents[$b] = $a;
                $queue[] = $b;
            }
    }
    $paths = [];
    foreach ($parents as $a => $unused) {
        $path = [];
        $current = $a;
        while ($current !== null) {
            $path[] = $current;
            $current = $parents[$current];
        }
        $paths[$a] = $path;
    }
    return [$parents, $paths];
}

function ringEdges(array $ring): array
{
    $edges = [];
    $n = count($ring);
    foreach ($ring as $i => $a)
        $edges[bondKey($ring[($i - 1 + $n) % $n], $a)] = true;
    return $edges;
}

function ringSequence(array $ring): array
{
    $first = array_search(min($ring), $ring, true);
    $forward = [...array_slice($ring, $first), ...array_slice($ring, 0, $first)];
    $backward = [$forward[0], ...array_reverse(array_slice($forward, 1))];
    return sequenceCompare($forward, $backward) < 0 ? $forward : $backward;
}

function findRings(Molecule $m): void
{
    $candidates = $seen = [];
    $bonds = $m->orderedBonds();
    $edgeIds = [];
    foreach ($bonds as $i => $b)
        $edgeIds[$b->key()] = $i;
    foreach ($m->atoms as $root => $unused) {
        [$parents, $paths] = breadthFirst($m, $root);
        foreach ($bonds as $b) {
            [$a, $c] = $b->ends;
            if ($parents[$a] === $c || $parents[$c] === $a)
                continue;
            $shared = array_intersect($paths[$a], $paths[$c]);
            if (count($shared) !== 1 || !in_array($root, $shared, true))
                continue;
            $sequence = [...array_reverse($paths[$a]), ...array_slice($paths[$c], 0, -1)];
            $ids = [];
            foreach (ringEdges($sequence) as $key => $unused)
                $ids[] = $edgeIds[$key];
            sort($ids, SORT_NUMERIC);
            $key = implode(',', $ids);
            if (!isset($seen[$key])) {
                $seen[$key] = true;
                $candidates[] = [
                    'sequence' => $sequence,
                    'edges' => array_fill_keys($ids, true),
                    'order' => count($candidates),
                ];
            }
        }
    }
    usort(
        $candidates,
        fn($a, $b) => count($a['sequence']) <=> count($b['sequence']) ?: $a['order'] <=> $b['order'],
    );
    $basis = $rings = [];
    foreach ($candidates as $c) {
        $reduced = $c['edges'];
        while ($reduced) {
            $pivot = max(array_keys($reduced));
            if (!isset($basis[$pivot])) {
                $basis[$pivot] = $reduced;
                $rings[] = ringSequence($c['sequence']);
                break;
            }
            foreach ($basis[$pivot] as $id => $unused) {
                if (isset($reduced[$id]))
                    unset($reduced[$id]);
                else
                    $reduced[$id] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    usort($rings, fn($a, $b) => count($a) <=> count($b) ?: sequenceCompare($a, $b));
    $m->rings = $rings;
    foreach ($rings as $ring) {
        foreach ($ring as $a)
            $m->ringAtoms[$a] = true;
        foreach (ringEdges($ring) as $key => $unused)
            $m->bonds[$key]->ring = true;
    }
}

function aromaticSystems(Molecule $m, array $needing): array
{
    $remaining = array_fill_keys($needing, true);
    $systems = [];
    while ($remaining) {
        $start = min(array_keys($remaining));
        unset($remaining[$start]);
        $queue = [$start];
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($queue); ++$i) {
            $neighbors = $m->neighbors[$queue[$i]];
            ksort($neighbors, SORT_NUMERIC);
            foreach ($neighbors as $b => $bond)
                if ($bond->kind === 4 && isset($remaining[$b])) {
                    unset($remaining[$b]);
                    $queue[] = $b;
                }
        }
        $systems[] = $queue;
    }
    return $systems;
}

function matchSystem(Molecule $m, array $system): ?array
{
    $unpaired = array_fill_keys($system, true);
    $pairs = [];
    $search = function () use (&$search, &$unpaired, &$pairs, $m): bool {
        if (!$unpaired)
            return true;
        $a = min(array_keys($unpaired));
        unset($unpaired[$a]);
        $neighbors = $m->neighbors[$a];
        ksort($neighbors, SORT_NUMERIC);
        foreach ($neighbors as $b => $bond)
            if (isset($unpaired[$b]) && $bond->kind === 4) {
                unset($unpaired[$b]);
                $pairs[] = $bond->key();
                if ($search())
                    return true;
                array_pop($pairs);
                $unpaired[$b] = true;
            }
        $unpaired[$a] = true;
        return false;
    };
    return $search() ? $pairs : null;
}

function kekulize(Molecule $m, array $needing): void
{
    $selected = [];
    foreach (aromaticSystems($m, $needing) as $system) {
        $pairs = matchSystem($m, $system);
        if ($pairs === null)
            throw new AnalysisError('kekulization failed', $m->atoms[min($system)]->column);
        foreach ($pairs as $key)
            $selected[$key] = true;
    }
    foreach ($m->bonds as $key => $b)
        $b->multiplicity = $b->kind === 4 ? (isset($selected[$key]) ? 2 : 1) : $b->kind;
}

<?php

final readonly class PatternAtom
{
    public function __construct(
        public ?array $choices = null,
        public ?bool $aromatic = null,
    ) {}

    public function matches(Atom $atom): bool
    {
        return (
            $this->choices !== null
                ? in_array([$atom->element->symbol, $atom->aromatic], $this->choices, true)
                : $this->aromatic === null
                || $this->aromatic === $atom->aromatic
        );
    }
}

function readPatternAtom(string $text, int $i, array $elements): array
{
    $ch = $text[$i];
    if (in_array($ch, ['*', 'A', 'a'], true))
        return [new PatternAtom(aromatic: $ch === '*' ? null : $ch === 'a'), $i + 1];
    if ($ch === '[') {
        $end = strpos($text, ']', $i + 1);
        if ($end === false)
            throw new AnalysisError('unclosed bracket', $i + 1);
        $choices = [];
        foreach (explode(',', substr($text, $i + 1, $end - $i - 1)) as $part) {
            $organic = readOrganic($part, 0);
            if ($organic === null || $organic[2] !== strlen($part))
                throw new AnalysisError('bad bracket atom', $i + 1);
            $choices[] = [$organic[0], $organic[1]];
        }
        return [new PatternAtom($choices), $end + 1];
    }
    $organic = readOrganic($text, $i);
    if ($organic === null)
        throw new AnalysisError('unexpected character', $i + 1);
    return [new PatternAtom([[$organic[0], $organic[1]]]), $organic[2]];
}

function moleculePattern(Molecule $m): Molecule
{
    $p = new Molecule($m->elements);
    foreach ($m->atoms as $a)
        $p->addAtom(new PatternAtom([[$a->element->symbol, $a->aromatic]]));
    foreach ($m->orderedBonds() as $b)
        $p->addBond($b->ends[0], $b->ends[1], $b->kind);
    return $p;
}

function bondMatches(Bond $pattern, Bond $bond): bool
{
    $symbol = $pattern->symbol;
    if ($symbol === null)
        return $bond->kind === 1 || $bond->kind === 4;
    if ($symbol === '~')
        return true;
    return $bond->kind === (is_string($symbol) ? BOND_TYPES[$symbol] : $symbol);
}

function embeddings(Molecule $pattern, Molecule $m): array
{
    if (count($pattern->atoms) > count($m->atoms))
        return [0, 0, null];
    $candidates = $earlier = [];
    foreach ($pattern->atoms as $i => $p) {
        $list = [];
        foreach ($m->atoms as $j => $a)
            if ($p->matches($a) && $m->degree($j) >= $pattern->degree($i))
                $list[] = $j;
        $candidates[] = $list;
        $earlier[$i] = array_filter($pattern->neighbors[$i], fn($bond, $j) => $j < $i, ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH);
    }
    $mapping = $used = $unique = [];
    $count = 0;
    $first = null;
    $assign = function (int $i) use (
        &$assign,
        &$mapping,
        &$used,
        &$unique,
        &$count,
        &$first,
        $candidates,
        $earlier,
        $pattern,
        $m,
    ): void {
        if ($i === count($pattern->atoms)) {
            ++$count;
            $set = array_keys($used);
            sort($set, SORT_NUMERIC);
            $unique[implode(',', $set)] = true;
            $first ??= $mapping;
            return;
        }
        foreach ($candidates[$i] as $a) {
            if (isset($used[$a]))
                continue;
            $valid = true;
            foreach ($earlier[$i] as $j => $bond) {
                $target = $m->neighbors[$a][$mapping[$j]] ?? null;
                if ($target === null || !bondMatches($bond, $target)) {
                    $valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($valid) {
                $mapping[] = $a;
                $used[$a] = true;
                $assign($i + 1);
                unset($used[$a]);
                array_pop($mapping);
            }
        }
    };
    $assign(0);
    return [$count, count($unique), $first];
}

function fingerprint(Molecule $m): array
{
    $codes = [];
    foreach ($m->atoms as $i => $a)
        $codes[] = (16 * $a->element->number) + (8 * (int) $a->aromatic) + $m->degree($i);
    $bits = $used = [];
    $count = 0;
    $extend = function (int $a, int $depth, int $value) use (
        &$extend,
        &$bits,
        &$used,
        &$count,
        $codes,
        $m,
    ): void {
        ++$count;
        $bits[$value % 1024] = true;
        if ($depth === 5)
            return;
        $neighbors = $m->neighbors[$a];
        ksort($neighbors, SORT_NUMERIC);
        foreach ($neighbors as $b => $bond)
            if (!isset($used[$b])) {
                $next = (($value * 31) + $bond->kind) % 1000003;
                $next = (($next * 31) + $codes[$b]) % 1000003;
                $used[$b] = true;
                $extend($b, $depth + 1, $next);
                unset($used[$b]);
            }
    };
    foreach ($codes as $a => $code) {
        $used[$a] = true;
        $extend($a, 0, $code);
        unset($used[$a]);
    }
    return [$bits, $count];
}

function tanimoto(array $a, array $b): array
{
    $common = count(array_intersect_key($a, $b));
    return [$common, count($a) + count($b) - $common];
}

function readOrganic(string $text, int $position): ?array
{
    $pair = substr($text, $position, 2);
    if ($pair === 'Cl' || $pair === 'Br')
        return [$pair, false, $position + 2];
    $ch = substr($text, $position, 1);
    if ($ch !== '' && str_contains('BCNOPSFI', $ch))
        return [$ch, false, $position + 1];
    if ($ch !== '' && str_contains('bcnops', $ch))
        return [strtoupper($ch), true, $position + 1];
    return null;
}

function readBracket(string $content, array $elements, int $column): Atom
{
    $i = 0;
    $length = strlen($content);
    while ($i < $length && ctype_digit($content[$i]))
        ++$i;
    if ($i >= 4 || $i > 0 && $content[0] === '0' || $i === $length)
        throw new AnalysisError('bad bracket atom', $column);
    $mass = $i ? (int) substr($content, 0, $i) : 0;
    $ch = $content[$i];
    if (str_contains('bcnops', $ch)) {
        $symbol = strtoupper($ch);
        $aromatic = true;
        ++$i;
    } elseif ($ch >= 'A' && $ch <= 'Z') {
        $pair = substr($content, $i, 2);
        if (strlen($pair) === 2 && $pair[1] >= 'a' && $pair[1] <= 'z' && isset($elements[$pair])) {
            $symbol = $pair;
            $i += 2;
        } elseif (isset($elements[$ch])) {
            $symbol = $ch;
            ++$i;
        } else
            throw new AnalysisError('unknown element', $column);
        $aromatic = false;
    } else
        throw new AnalysisError('bad bracket atom', $column);
    if (substr($content, $i, 2) === '@@')
        $i += 2;
    elseif (substr($content, $i, 1) === '@')
        ++$i;
    $hydrogens = 0;
    if (substr($content, $i, 1) === 'H') {
        $hydrogens = 1;
        ++$i;
        if ($i < $length && ctype_digit($content[$i]))
            $hydrogens = (int) $content[$i++];
    }
    $charge = 0;
    $sign = substr($content, $i, 1);
    if ($sign === '+' || $sign === '-') {
        $charge = $sign === '+' ? 1 : -1;
        ++$i;
        if ($i < $length && $content[$i] >= '1' && $content[$i] <= '9')
            $charge *= (int) $content[$i++];
    }
    if ($i !== $length)
        throw new AnalysisError('bad bracket atom', $column);
    return new Atom($elements[$symbol], $aromatic, $mass, $charge, $hydrogens, true, $column);
}

function readAtom(string $text, int $i, array $elements): array
{
    if ($text[$i] === '[') {
        $end = strpos($text, ']', $i + 1);
        if ($end === false)
            throw new AnalysisError('unclosed bracket', $i + 1);
        return [readBracket(substr($text, $i + 1, $end - $i - 1), $elements, $i + 1), $end + 1];
    }
    $organic = readOrganic($text, $i);
    if ($organic === null)
        throw new AnalysisError('unexpected character', $i + 1);
    [$symbol, $aromatic, $end] = $organic;
    return [new Atom($elements[$symbol], $aromatic, column: $i + 1), $end];
}

function parseSmiles(string $text, array $elements, bool $pattern = false): Molecule
{
    $m = new Molecule($elements);
    $symbols = $pattern ? ['-' => 1, '=' => 2, '#' => 3, ':' => 4, '~' => 5] : BOND_TYPES;
    $current = $pending = null;
    $branches = $open = [];
    $i = 0;
    while ($i < strlen($text)) {
        $ch = $text[$i];
        $column = $i + 1;
        if (isset($symbols[$ch])) {
            if ($current === null || $pending !== null)
                throw new AnalysisError('misplaced bond', $column);
            $pending = [$ch, $column];
            ++$i;
        } elseif ($ch === '(') {
            if ($current === null || $pending !== null || $i > 0 && $text[$i - 1] === '(')
                throw new AnalysisError('misplaced branch', $column);
            $branches[] = [$current, $column];
            ++$i;
        } elseif ($ch === ')') {
            if (!$branches)
                throw new AnalysisError('unmatched parenthesis', $column);
            if ($pending !== null)
                throw new AnalysisError('dangling bond', $pending[1]);
            if ($i > 0 && $text[$i - 1] === '(')
                throw new AnalysisError('empty branch', $column);
            [$current, $opening] = array_pop($branches);
            ++$i;
        } elseif (ctype_digit($ch) || $ch === '%') {
            if ($current === null)
                throw new AnalysisError('misplaced ring closure', $column);
            if ($ch === '%') {
                $digits = substr($text, $i + 1, 2);
                if (strlen($digits) !== 2 || !ctype_digit($digits))
                    throw new AnalysisError('bad ring number', $column);
                $ring = (int) $digits;
                $i += 3;
            } else {
                $ring = (int) $ch;
                ++$i;
            }
            $symbol = $pending[0] ?? null;
            $pending = null;
            if (!isset($open[$ring])) {
                $open[$ring] = [$current, $symbol, $column];
                continue;
            }
            [$first, $initial, $opening] = $open[$ring];
            if ($first === $current)
                throw new AnalysisError('self bond', $column);
            if ($initial !== null && $symbol !== null && $symbols[$initial] !== $symbols[$symbol])
                throw new AnalysisError('ring bond mismatch', $column);
            if (isset($m->neighbors[$first][$current]))
                throw new AnalysisError('duplicate bond', $column);
            $m->addBond($first, $current, $symbol ?? $initial);
            unset($open[$ring]);
        } else {
            [$atom, $next] = $pattern
                ? readPatternAtom($text, $i, $elements)
                : readAtom($text, $i, $elements);
            $new = $m->addAtom($atom);
            if ($current !== null)
                $m->addBond($current, $new, $pending[0] ?? null);
            $current = $new;
            $pending = null;
            $i = $next;
        }
    }
    if ($pending !== null)
        throw new AnalysisError('dangling bond', $pending[1]);
    if ($branches)
        throw new AnalysisError('unmatched parenthesis', $branches[0][1]);
    if ($open)
        throw new AnalysisError('unclosed ring', min(array_column($open, 2)));
    return $m;
}
